title: Results of the nitrogen question: the table of means
intro: The nitrogen question was run on the built-in farm for the years 1990 to 1993 with the built-in Taastrup weather. After the run the results appear under the options: a list that chooses the run to look at, three buttons, a table of the mean per season and the figures.

marks.d: Chooses the run whose single run figures are drawn.
Saves all results and figures as one HTML report.

marks.t: Put the logs in the Files list
marks.d: Keeps the Daisy logs of the runs in the Files tab for the plot and balance tabs.

marks.t: Open the set-up in the editor
marks.d: Opens the Daisy set-up of the run in the Set-up editor.
The mean of each result over the seasons, one column for each run.
